$comment: Runner settings for this repository's MuJoCo walk check. Not a specification format: scenario parameters come from the pinned walk-hallway scenario and the selected configuration profile. Trials start at the exact nominal pose; this file has no seeds and no noise.

sample_hz.reason: One sample per controller step; metrics are evaluated from this recording.

wall_contact_model: Conservative world-AABB gap between every robot body geom and each wall box; the walls are visual only so the published model and its collision geoms stay unchanged. A sample with gap <= 0 counts as a wall contact.
